title: Dysprosium Triangles Showing Single-Molecule Magnet Behavior of Thermally Excited Spin States

material_class.structural_family: μ3-hydroxo-capped Dy3 triangle with phenoxo-bridging o-vanillinate

synthesis.procedure: DyCl3·6H2O (1.0 mmol) was added to a stirred solution of o-vanillin (1.0 mmol), 2-aminoethanol (1.0 mmol) and triethylamine (1.0 mmol) in methanol (40 mL). Slow evaporation of the yellow solution over 2 weeks gave X-ray quality yellow block crystals. Yield 98 mg (21.5%). Anal. calcd for 1·15H2O: C, 21.63; H, 3.55. Found: C, 21.62; H, 3.71. IR (KBr) cm−1: 3200 (br), 1638 (s), 1555 (m), 1448 (s), 1216 (s), 948 (m), 728 (m).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow block crystals formed by slow evaporation of the methanol solution over 2 weeks.

properties.summary: Compound 1 is magnetically equivalent to 2 within residual-orientation error. Room-temperature χT matches three uncoupled Dy(III) ions and χT falls nearly to zero at low T, with a susceptibility maximum near 6.5 K. Crystal-field modeling of non-interacting ions accounts for the decrease only down to about 30 K; a further drop is ascribed to intratrimer antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization shows a step near 0.95 T and reaches 15.6 μB at 7 T. Frequency-dependent ac susceptibility below 20 K indicates slow relaxation of a thermally populated excited state despite an almost non-magnetic ground state (SMM-like behavior).

material_class.structural_family: μ3-hydroxo-capped Dy3 triangle with phenoxo-bridging o-vanillinate

synthesis.procedure: The same reaction used for 1 was performed in 40 mL methanol/acetonitrile (50:50): DyCl3·6H2O (1.0 mmol) added to o-vanillin (1.0 mmol), 2-aminoethanol (1.0 mmol) and triethylamine (1.0 mmol). Rectangular yellow plates of 2 were obtained. Yield 120 mg (26.3%). Anal. calcd for 2·8.7H2O·0.3CH3CN: C, 21.48; H, 3.76; N, 0.31. Found: C, 21.26; H, 3.46; N, 0.35. IR (KBr) cm−1: 3390 (br), 1635 (s), 1555 (m), 1448 (s), 1218 (s), 948 (m), 728 (m).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Rectangular yellow plates of 2 crystallized from the methanol/acetonitrile solution.

properties.summary: Static magnetism of 2 matches 1: χT is 40.5 emu K mol−1 at room temperature and falls nearly to zero at low temperature, with χ maximized near 6.5 K. The drop below 30 K is not reproduced by crystal-field splitting of isolated Dy(III) ions and is attributed to intratriangle antiferromagnetic exchange, giving an almost non-magnetic ground state. Magnetization steps near 0.95 T (1.8 K) and, on a single crystal, is orientation-dependent by micro-SQUID at 0.1 K, with a small hysteresis below and above Hc. Ac susceptibility is strongly frequency dependent below 20 K. High-temperature relaxation follows τ = 2.2×10^−8 exp(61.7/T) and saturates at low T; τ vs field at 7.15 K shows minima at zero field and near 0.9 T, consistent with resonant quantum tunneling of a thermally excited magnetic state.
